scientific_integrity: The proof independently derives likelihood, score bracket, LAN and efficient MLE from a publicly stated transition kernel. Finite rational checks and seeded simulation are supporting diagnostics and are not replacements for the proof; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Interior p in (0,1), exact full-path observation, pointwise first-order asymptotics; no statement for censored paths, noisy observations, boundary p, or finite-sample minimaxity.
title: Logarithmic Fisher information and pathwise local asymptotic normality for the discrete Poisson staircase
